name: greenlite
description: Mobile command + approval cockpit for your AI agents. Approve, edit, or deny agent actions from your phone. Android + iOS via Expo.

scripts.export:web: env -u FORCE_COLOR -u NO_COLOR expo export -p web --output-dir dist/mobile
scripts.build:console: cd web-app && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:web: rm -rf dist && npm run export:web && npm run build:console && cp -r web/. dist/
